steps.title: Given an authenticated Editor opens the wizard
When the Editor types milka in the Brand search field
When the Editor adds the market Morocco
Then the language Arabic is auto-detected for Morocco
When the Editor clicks Discover Categories
And the Editor accepts the AI-discovered categories without modification
When the Editor clicks Review Prompts
And the system generates default questions for each category
Then the Review summary shows the Markets Categories and Total Prompts cards
And the Editor selects the LLMs: ChatGPT, Gemini
When the Editor clicks Review & Launch
Then the user is redirected to the report overview
